      have h₇ : (p : ℤ) ∣ n := by

        exact (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by simpa [Nat.cast_inj] using hp)).dvd_of_dvd_pow h₈
      exact h₇
    exact h₄
  
  
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h₁ h
  · intro h
    exact h₂ h
